title: File:(Landscape of Mount Piora in Papua New Guinea) - DPLA - 721349ed5549e3f0db8e6063ae67ddc4.jpg
author: Carlquist, Sherwin John, 1930-2021
description: Landscape photograph of Mount Piora in Papua New Guinea. The bottom of the photograph has brown grass that continues over multiple peaks before a dark brown mountain in the background. A scattering of clouds surround the distant mountain peaks. The sky is blue with wisps of clouds. In the center, a white airplane is flying away from the photographer.1 photograph : positive, col. ; 35 mm.
